title.value: Magnetoencephalography resting-state correlates of executive and language components of verbal fluency
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper on correlating magnetoencephalography (MEG) data with verbal fluency tests, highlighting executive and language components.
title.quote: Magnetoencephalography resting‐state correlates of executive and language components of verbal fluency

extractions.description: The paper investigates the neural correlates of executive and language components of verbal fluency using magnetoencephalography (MEG). It aims to distinguish brain activities associated with different cognitive processes during a verbal fluency test, utilizing cluster-level statistics across frequency bands.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper centers on cognitive neuroscience and neuropsychology, focusing on brain activity during verbal fluency tasks and not on sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The purpose of this study was to elucidate the specificity of the resting state MEG correlates of the executive and language components.
